name: revenantworks
description: The Revenantworks skills marketplace — every Revenantworks Agent Skill pack. Each pack installs as one plugin; every skill inside stands alone.

plugins.name: foundation
plugins.description: Eleven standalone wrights: skillwright (skills & packs), promptwright (prompts), commwright (messages), agentwright (agent specs), rigwright (standing Claude config), lorewright (research verdicts & playbooks), evalwright (eval suites), brandwright (brand & voice), tokenwright (token footprint), dispatchwright (fan-out dispatch), resumewright (committed session handoffs). Each routes on its own description and works alone; together they cover the full build-audit-ship loop.

plugins.name: gamedev
plugins.description: Game-development skills on the -smith motif. First member: pixelsmith — art direction for pixel art that must read at several zoom scales at once (per-band rules, terrain-versus-unit contrast, a one-scene look test, artist and generator briefs). Each routes on its own description and works alone.

plugins.name: localops
plugins.description: Skills for running work on local models, on the -runner motif. First member: lmstudiorunner — hands work to an LM Studio model and verifies what comes back, scoring the task's shape first, auditing installed models from live metadata rather than a hardcoded list, and requiring a machine check for anything nobody will read.
